inputs.name: supply scaling
inputs.cite: A5 q1 and derived line; parameters mutation.supply_ratio_kappa

day.reading: G_f is a measured LTEE total throughput; supply, selection and parallelism are inside it
day.holds: F_max takes them through G_f only; the open step is transferring G_f to humans

critic.reading: the formula has no mutation rate or selection coefficient, so it is not a test of selection
critic.holds: literally true: F_max is identical at two test points that differ in mu, N and s

notes: The identity is structural: F_max is a function of (t_div, d, g_len, G_f) only. Both readings agree on that; they differ on whether an empirical G_f can carry the supply, selection and parallelism of a different organism. The supply ratios the claim files cite (genome 674-689x; per-genome supply kappa 93,659) are asserted as arithmetic; G2h's verdict comment says they favour the critic on transfer, which is an external question (A5, A2e), and the objection restates the supply objection (M-103).
